title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! How to apply: Follow us @young.onion, comment with favorite emoji and tag a friend, send DM with portfolio or fill application form in bio. Email: info@youngonion.in
